background.value: White, color photo, full front view of face

cross_verification.note_en: Multiple embassies.gov.il subdomains (USA, Berlin, Atlanta, Los Angeles -- Israeli Ministry of Foreign Affairs pages) consistently state '5x5 cm' for entry/work visa photos, distinct from the 35x45mm figure used for Israeli citizens' own biometric passport (see il-passport.json). Direct WebFetch access to embassies.gov.il was blocked on every attempt; confirmation relies on web-search indexing that directly surfaced these specific gov.il URLs with a consistently repeated figure across multiple independent queries and mirror subdomains. DB's size value (3.5x4.5cm) appears to conflate the passport figure with the visa figure -- logged as a conflict; DB not modified per instructions.
